drivingQuestion: Why is the sciatic nerve not nullified by the majority of permitted sinews?
outcomeNote: The difficulty raised in the previous unit is answered by the beriya distinction; the unit is the answer alone.

segments.en: The Gemara answers that the sciatic nerve is a distinct «entity,» and therefore it «is different» in that it is not subject to nullification.

moves.summary: answers the standing וליבטול ברובא difficulty: a distinct entity is not nullified
moves.about: answering its own difficulty — the sciatic nerve is a distinct entity (בריה) and a distinct entity is never nullified by a majority
